note: CISA KEV, the official cisagov/kev-data mirror, pinned to the commit that added the 2026-11-25 catalogue. www.cisa.gov answers HTTP 403 to this deployment's egress for every path (Akamai IP denial; measured 2026-11-27), so it is not a configured source and nothing falls back to it. A refresh is a pin bump: commit in url, size_bytes, sha256, version and catalog_version together.
